name: en_equivalent_units
description: Limits written in different units: 30 minutes = 1800 seconds and 2 GB = 2048 MB are the same rule; 500 ms vs 2 seconds for the same API is a real contradiction. Upload limits without the failure path.
requirements:
REQ-1: The session expires after 30 minutes of inactivity.
REQ-2: The session expires after 1800 seconds of inactivity.
REQ-3: Uploaded files must not exceed 2 GB.
REQ-4: Uploaded files must not exceed 2048 MB.
REQ-5: The search API must respond within 500 ms.
REQ-6: The search API must respond within 2 seconds.

issues.note: what the user sees when the session expires

rule.contradiction.REQ-5+REQ-6.value: REQ-6: The search API must respond within 2 seconds.

rule.missing_error_handling.REQ-3.value: A larger file is rejected with an error that names the limit.

rule.missing_error_handling.REQ-4.value: A larger file is rejected with an error that names the limit.

answers_by_text.value: The user is taken to the sign-in page with a session-expired message.

questions.question: What does the user see after the session expires?
questions.reason: The expiry test needs an observable result.

questions.question: Is the timeout 30 minutes or 1800 seconds?
questions.reason: Asks about a difference that does not exist.
